draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.40, the 20th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 2nd of 27 at CB. He lasted until pick 101, well after his grade rank (20th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Tyson Campbell. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 7 passes defended in 2024, 16th of 27 CBs in his class with stats.
